scope.label: enterprise-security-audit
scope.notes: Authorized defensive discovery scan for unauthorized or unapproved shadow AI instances across engineering subnets.

executive_summary: Discovery identified 2 total AI service endpoint(s), including 2 unapproved shadow AI deployment(s). The highest-severity risk identified is a MEDIUM exposure on ollama (127.0.0.1:11435), driven by: No authentication required (+3.0), Exposes active models or tools: 2 listed (+1.5). Priority action: Set OLLAMA_HOST=127.0.0.1:11434 in environment or service configuration..

risk_factors: Exposes active models or tools: 2 listed (+1.5)
remediation: Set OLLAMA_HOST=127.0.0.1:11434 in environment or service configuration.
Upgrade to Ollama >= 0.1.34 to patch CVE-2024-37032.
Do not expose Ollama port 11434 to untrusted networks without an authenticating reverse proxy.
Enable API key or bearer token authentication in the service configuration.
Place an authenticating reverse proxy (e.g., Caddy, Envoy, LiteLLM with master key) in front of the listener.
Audit and restrict model listing endpoints (/v1/models, /api/tags) to authenticated callers.
Remove unapproved or proprietary fine-tuned model weights from public storage directories.
Review this discovery with the security/compliance team. Add to approved.yaml if legitimate, or decommission.
framework_tags: OWASP LLM01:2025 Model Denial of Service
NIST AI RMF MAP 1.1 (AI System Context & Asset Inventory)

remediation: Enable WEBUI_AUTH=True in Open WebUI environment variables.
Disable untrusted custom tools and restrict admin account creation.
Upgrade Open WebUI to >= 0.3.10.
Review this discovery with the security/compliance team. Add to approved.yaml if legitimate, or decommission.
